--DELETE FROM EDS.DIGITAL_NON_FIN_TXN_FACT WHERE TXN_DATE = CAST(@process_date AS DATE);

WITH DIGITAL_NON_FIN_TXN_FACT_MBK
AS
(
	SELECT 
		B.BNK_CODE AS BANK_ID,
		EOMONTH(CAST(B.audit_date AS DATE)) AS TXN_DATE,
		B.CIF_NO AS CIF_ID,
		B.[USERNAME] AS USER_NAME,
		COUNT(B.APP_ID) AS TRXN_COUNT,
		B.STATUS AS TXN_STATUS,
		B.AUDIT_ACTION AS TXN_TYPE,
		B.PHONE_MODEL AS DEVICE_NAME,
		B.SOURCE_CODE AS SOURCE_CODE,
		NULL AS GROSS_TXN_FEE,
		NULL AS NET_TXN_FEE,
		NULL AS GROSS_FEE_INCOME,
		NULL AS NET_FEE_INCOME,
		CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS INSERT_DTTM
	FROM 
	  (
		SELECT 
		  username, 
		  cif_no, 
		  audit_date, 
		  app_id, 
		  audit_action, 
		  [status], 
		  primaryfield, 
		  phone_model,
		  mbk.bnk_code,
		  mbk.source_code	  
		FROM 
		  (
			SELECT 
			  Trim(user_id) USERNAME, 
			  cif_no 
			FROM 
			  eds.mbk_rtbkcustomermtb 
			WHERE 
			  bnk_code = 'CBC01'
			GROUP BY
			  Trim(user_id), 
			  cif_no 
		  ) CUST 
		  JOIN (
			SELECT 
				  APP_ID, 
				  AUDIT_DATE, 
				  PHONE_NO, 
				  ACCESS_TYPE, 
				  AUDIT_ACTION, 
				  SERVICE_INPUT, 
				  MERCHANT_ID, 
				  IP, 
				  AUDIT_FIELD1, 
				  AUDIT_FIELD2, 
				  AUDIT_FIELD3, 
				  AUDIT_FIELD4, 
				  AUDIT_FIELD5, 
				  AUDIT_FIELD6, 
				  AUDIT_FIELD7, 
				  AUDIT_FIELD8, 
				  AUDIT_FIELD9, 
				  AUDIT_FIELD10, 
				  ACCESS_CHANNEL, 
				  TRIM(PRIMARYFIELD) PRIMARYFIELD, 
				  SECONDARYFIELD, 
				  HEADERDUMP, 
				  GPRSPHONENO, 
				  ARCHIVAL_STATUS, 
				  STATUS, 
				  PHONE_MODEL,
				  SOURCE_CODE,
				  BNK_CODE
			FROM 
			  eds.mbk_auditmtb 
			WHERE 
			  bnk_code = 'CBC01' 
		  ) MBK ON CUST.username = MBK.primaryfield 
	  ) B 
	GROUP BY 
		B.BNK_CODE,
		EOMONTH(CAST(B.audit_date AS DATE)),
		B.CIF_NO,
		B.[USERNAME],
		B.STATUS,
		B.AUDIT_ACTION,
		B.PHONE_MODEL,
		B.SOURCE_CODE
)

,DIGITAL_NON_FIN_TXN_FACT_RIB
AS
(
	SELECT 
		A.BANK_ID,
		--CURRENT_MONTH_END AS TXN_DATE, 
		EOMONTH(CAST(LOGIN_TIME AS DATE)) AS TXN_DATE,
		B.CUST_ID AS CIF_ID,
		A.ACTUAL_USER_ID AS USER_NAME,
		COUNT(A.SESSION_ID) AS TRXN_COUNT, 
		[STATUS] AS TXN_STATUS, 
		'LOGIN' AS TXN_TYPE, 
		NULL AS DEVICE_NAME,
		A.SOURCE_CODE AS SOURCE_CODE,
		NULL AS GROSS_TXN_FEE,
		NULL AS NET_TXN_FEE,
		NULL AS GROSS_FEE_INCOME,
		NULL AS NET_FEE_INCOME,
		CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS INSERT_DTTM
	FROM 
	  eds.RIB_MONITORINGLOGINHISTORYTABLE A 
	  INNER JOIN (
		select 
		  ROW_NUMBER() over(
			PARTITION by TRIM(CORP_USER), 
			BNK_CODE 
			ORDER BY 
			  SCD_START_DATE
		  ) RN, 
		  * 
		FROM 
		  eds.RIB_CORPORATEUSER
	  ) B ON B.BNK_CODE = A.BNK_CODE 
	  AND B.CORP_USER = LEFT(
		A.ACTUAL_USER_ID, 
		CHARINDEX('.', A.ACTUAL_USER_ID)-1
	  ) 
	  AND CAST(LOGIN_TIME AS DATE) BETWEEN CASE WHEN B.RN = 1 THEN B.R_CRE_TIME ELSE B.SCD_START_DATE END 
	  AND B.SCD_END_DATE 
	  INNER JOIN eds.DATE_DIM DTE ON DTE.FULLDATE = CAST(LOGIN_TIME AS DATE) 
	WHERE 
	  A.BANK_ID = 'CBC01' 
	  AND LEFT(B.CUST_ID, 1) = 'R' 
	  AND B.DEL_FLG = 'N' 

	GROUP BY 
		A.BANK_ID,
		--CURRENT_MONTH_END, 
		EOMONTH(CAST(LOGIN_TIME AS DATE)),
		B.CUST_ID,
		A.ACTUAL_USER_ID,
		[STATUS], 
		A.SOURCE_CODE
	  
	  
	  
	UNION ALL 


	SELECT 
		BANK_ID,
		TXN_DATE,
		CIF_ID,
		USER_NAME,
		TRXN_COUNT, 
		TXN_STATUS, 
		TXN_TYPE, 
		DEVICE_NAME,
		SOURCE_CODE,
		GROSS_TXN_FEE,
		NET_TXN_FEE,
		SUM(TRXN_COUNT * GROSS_TXN_FEE) AS GROSS_FEE_INCOME,
		SUM(TRXN_COUNT * NET_TXN_FEE) AS NET_FEE_INCOME,
		CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS INSERT_DTTM
	FROM 
	(
	SELECT 
		REQ.BANK_ID,
		--CURRENT_MONTH_END AS TXN_DATE, 
		EOMONTH(CAST(AS_OF_DATE AS DATE)) AS TXN_DATE,
		CORP.CUST_ID AS CIF_ID,
		REQ.CORP_USER AS USER_NAME,
		COUNT(REQ.FTXN_ID) AS TRXN_COUNT, 
		REQ.FORM_REQ_STATE AS TXN_STATUS, 
		REQ.RQST_ID AS TXN_TYPE, 
		NULL AS DEVICE_NAME,
		REQ.SOURCE_CODE AS SOURCE_CODE,
		DBD1.GROSS_TXN_FEE AS GROSS_TXN_FEE,
		DBD1.NET_TXN_FEE AS NET_TXN_FEE
	FROM 
	  eds.RIB_REQUESTDETAILS REQ 
	  INNER JOIN (
		select 
		  ROW_NUMBER() over(
			PARTITION by TRIM(CORP_USER), 
			BNK_CODE 
			ORDER BY 
			  SCD_START_DATE
		  ) RN, 
		  * 
		FROM 
		  eds.RIB_CORPORATEUSER
	  ) CORP ON CORP.BANK_ID = REQ.BANK_ID 
	  AND CORP.CORP_USER = REQ.CORP_USER 
	  AND REQ.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN CASE WHEN CORP.RN = 1 THEN CORP.R_CRE_TIME ELSE CORP.SCD_START_DATE END 
	  AND CORP.SCD_END_DATE 
	  INNER JOIN eds.DATE_DIM DTE ON DTE.FULLDATE = AS_OF_DATE
	  LEFT JOIN EDS.DIGITAL_BILLERS_DIM DBD1
			ON REQ.RQST_ID = DBD1.TXN_TYPE
	WHERE 
	  REQ.BANK_ID = 'CBC01' 
	  AND REQ.DEL_FLG = 'N' 
	  AND CORP.DEL_FLG = 'N' 

	GROUP BY 
		REQ.BANK_ID,
		--CURRENT_MONTH_END AS TXN_DATE, 
		EOMONTH(CAST(AS_OF_DATE AS DATE)),
		CORP.CUST_ID,
		REQ.CORP_USER,
		REQ.FORM_REQ_STATE, 
		REQ.RQST_ID, 
		REQ.SOURCE_CODE,
		DBD1.GROSS_TXN_FEE,
		DBD1.NET_TXN_FEE
	) A
	GROUP BY
		BANK_ID,
		TXN_DATE,
		CIF_ID,
		USER_NAME,
		TRXN_COUNT, 
		TXN_STATUS, 
		TXN_TYPE, 
		DEVICE_NAME,
		SOURCE_CODE,
		GROSS_TXN_FEE,
		NET_TXN_FEE
)
,DIGITAL_NON_FIN_TXN_FACT_D30
AS
(
	SELECT 
		'CBC01' AS BANK_ID,
		EOMONTH(CASE WHEN ISDATE(A.[Transaction Date])=1 THEN CAST(A.[Transaction Date] AS DATE) END)  AS TXN_DATE,  
		B.CIF_ID AS CIF_ID, 
		B.[USERNAME] AS USER_NAME, 
		COUNT(*) AS TXN_COUNT, 
		A.[Status] AS TXN_STATUS,
		A.[Transaction Type] AS TXN_TYPE, 
		B.DEVICE_OS AS DEVICE_NAME, 
		'D30' AS SOURCE_CODE,
		NULL AS GROSS_TXN_FEE,
		NULL AS NET_TXN_FEE,
		NULL AS GROSS_FEE_INCOME,
		NULL AS NET_FEE_INCOME,
		CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS INSERT_DTTM
	FROM 
		eds.d30_TransactionReport A 
	INNER JOIN eds.d30_Customer B 
		ON B.USERNAME = A.UserName 
	WHERE 
		[Transaction Category] = 'Non-Financial' 
		AND ISDATE(A.[Transaction Date])=1
	GROUP BY 
		EOMONTH(CASE WHEN ISDATE(A.[Transaction Date])=1 THEN CAST(A.[Transaction Date] AS DATE) END), 
		B.CIF_ID, 
		B.[USERNAME], 
		A.[Status],
		A.[Transaction Type], 
		B.DEVICE_OS
)

INSERT INTO EDS.DIGITAL_NON_FIN_TXN_FACT
(
	 BANK_ID
	,TXN_DATE
	,CIF_ID
	,USER_NAME
	,TXN_COUNT
	,TXN_STATUS
	,TXN_TYPE
	,DEVICE_NAME
	,SOURCE_CODE
	,GROSS_TXN_FEE
	,NET_TXN_FEE
	,GROSS_FEE_INCOME
	,NET_FEE_INCOME
	,INSERT_DTTM
)

SELECT 
	CAST(BANK_ID AS varchar(8)) BANK_ID
	,CAST(TXN_DATE AS date) TXN_DATE
	,CAST(CIF_ID AS varchar(20)) CIF_ID
	,CAST(USER_NAME AS varchar(80)) USER_NAME
	,CAST(TRXN_COUNT AS bigint) TXN_COUNT
	,CAST(TXN_STATUS AS varchar(40)) TXN_STATUS
	,CAST(TXN_TYPE AS varchar(120)) TXN_TYPE
	,CAST(DEVICE_NAME AS varchar(250)) DEVICE_NAME
	,CAST(SOURCE_CODE AS varchar(20)) SOURCE_CODE
	,CAST(GROSS_TXN_FEE AS numeric(5,2)) GROSS_TXN_FEE
	,CAST(NET_TXN_FEE AS numeric(5,2)) NET_TXN_FEE
	,CAST(GROSS_FEE_INCOME AS numeric(15,5)) GROSS_FEE_INCOME
	,CAST(NET_FEE_INCOME AS numeric(15,5)) NET_FEE_INCOME
	,CAST(INSERT_DTTM AS datetime) INSERT_DTTM
FROM DIGITAL_NON_FIN_TXN_FACT_MBK
 
UNION ALL
 
SELECT 
	CAST(BANK_ID AS varchar(8)) BANK_ID
	,CAST(TXN_DATE AS date) TXN_DATE
	,CAST(CIF_ID AS varchar(20)) CIF_ID
	,CAST(USER_NAME AS varchar(80)) USER_NAME
	,CAST(TRXN_COUNT AS bigint) TXN_COUNT
	,CAST(TXN_STATUS AS varchar(40)) TXN_STATUS
	,CAST(TXN_TYPE AS varchar(120)) TXN_TYPE
	,CAST(DEVICE_NAME AS varchar(250)) DEVICE_NAME
	,CAST(SOURCE_CODE AS varchar(20)) SOURCE_CODE
	,CAST(GROSS_TXN_FEE AS numeric(5,2)) GROSS_TXN_FEE
	,CAST(NET_TXN_FEE AS numeric(5,2)) NET_TXN_FEE
	,CAST(GROSS_FEE_INCOME AS numeric(15,5)) GROSS_FEE_INCOME
	,CAST(NET_FEE_INCOME AS numeric(15,5)) NET_FEE_INCOME
	,CAST(INSERT_DTTM AS datetime) INSERT_DTTM
FROM DIGITAL_NON_FIN_TXN_FACT_RIB
 
UNION ALL
 
SELECT 
	CAST(BANK_ID AS varchar(8)) BANK_ID
	,CAST(TXN_DATE AS date) TXN_DATE
	,CAST(CIF_ID AS varchar(20)) CIF_ID
	,CAST(USER_NAME AS varchar(80)) USER_NAME
	,CAST(TXN_COUNT AS bigint) TXN_COUNT
	,CAST(TXN_STATUS AS varchar(40)) TXN_STATUS
	,CAST(TXN_TYPE AS varchar(120)) TXN_TYPE
	,CAST(DEVICE_NAME AS varchar(250)) DEVICE_NAME
	,CAST(SOURCE_CODE AS varchar(20)) SOURCE_CODE
	,CAST(GROSS_TXN_FEE AS numeric(5,2)) GROSS_TXN_FEE
	,CAST(NET_TXN_FEE AS numeric(5,2)) NET_TXN_FEE
	,CAST(GROSS_FEE_INCOME AS numeric(15,5)) GROSS_FEE_INCOME
	,CAST(NET_FEE_INCOME AS numeric(15,5)) NET_FEE_INCOME
	,CAST(INSERT_DTTM AS datetime) INSERT_DTTM
FROM DIGITAL_NON_FIN_TXN_FACT_D30
